|errata_history=This is the only version of a '''retired''' Virtual Modern card. '''Retired:''' the PC removed this card with the Virtual Set 18 / April 2022 errata release. Its images were deleted from the Holotable repository on 20 April 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2640d508acff17553640735ee7a15ad93fa78a65 holotable commit 2640d50]); the PC card data lists it as GEMP <code>200_16</code> (“•Jabba's Prize/Jabba's Prize (V)”) up to 18 April 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/9bab44f0b7b638bc4a62b2e911d8d4d0604ceade card-json commit 9bab44f]; title with “(V)” since [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/2060903ba1d4e5072706c7706ca52688e130420e card-json commit 2060903], 26 July 2021), and from 21 April 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/2293de287fa9905748ec7d665488e465872dbe4a card-json commit 2293de2], “Set 18 added!”) slot <code>200_16</code> holds [[The Mythrol / •The Mythrol]], an unrelated card (Bill, 12 Nov 2026: Jabba's Prize (V) is not part of The Mythrol's family). Bill ruled (12 November 2026, on [[Jabba's Prize (V)]] and [[The Mythrol / •The Mythrol]]) that a card whose GEMP slot was reused for another card is not part of the new card's family, so this card keeps its own version history here and is not listed with [[The Mythrol / •The Mythrol]]. The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-L-jabbasprizefront-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository. Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''Errata mark:''' the earliest image found already prints “E”: the PC had issued an errata of this card before its image repository began (8 July 2018), and no image of the earlier text was found. Listed with the [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription errors]] (marks that do not match the version).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-V0-L-jabbasprizefront022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/jabbasprizefront.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018). Status of the file today: the PC deleted the file on 20 April 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2640d508acff17553640735ee7a15ad93fa78a65 holotable commit 2640d50]) when the card was retired.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “•Jabba's Prize”. Back: [[:File:V0-L-jabbasprizeback-2018-07-08.gif]] (the carbonite image; no text). Text: “Jabba's Prize is a Light Side card and does not count towards your deck limit. Reveal to opponent when deploying your Starting Effect. For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Maintenance] Falcon. Deploys only at start of game if Jabba's Prize is at Security Tower (replaces opponent's Jabba's Prize imprisoned in Security Tower); otherwise place out of play. May not be placed in Reserve Deck. Jabba's Prize is a persona of Corran Horn only while on table. If Jabba's Prize was just released or leaves table, place it out of play. While Jabba's Prize is at Audience Chamber, opponent's battle destiny draws there are +1.”
* '''Retired''' (20 April 2022): the PC removed this card with the Virtual Set 18 / April 2022 errata release. Its images were deleted from the Holotable repository on 20 April 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2640d508acff17553640735ee7a15ad93fa78a65 holotable commit 2640d50]); the PC card data lists it as GEMP <code>200_16</code> (“•Jabba's Prize/Jabba's Prize (V)”) up to 18 April 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/9bab44f0b7b638bc4a62b2e911d8d4d0604ceade card-json commit 9bab44f]; title with “(V)” since [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/2060903ba1d4e5072706c7706ca52688e130420e card-json commit 2060903], 26 July 2021), and from 21 April 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/2293de287fa9905748ec7d665488e465872dbe4a card-json commit 2293de2], “Set 18 added!”) slot <code>200_16</code> holds [[The Mythrol / •The Mythrol]], an unrelated card (Bill, 12 Nov 2026: Jabba's Prize (V) is not part of The Mythrol's family).
